strings.name: string.quoted.double.mialu
strings.comment: A string has no escape sequences, so a backslash is invalid, and it ends with its line.

attributes.name: meta.attribute.mialu
attributes.comment: An attribute list: a # and one or more attributes, each of them a name between parentheses, as in #(static). It ends at the first thing that is not another attribute. The names are scoped as attribute names, so a theme can give them a color of their own, and they are not taken for calls or reserved words.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.range.mialu
patterns.comment: The end of a range in a for statement, exclusive or inclusive. It comes before the comparisons, so that the < and <= in it are not taken for them.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.address.mialu
patterns.comment: The % before an expression, which takes its address, as in %x.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.pointer.mialu
patterns.comment: The ^ of a pointer type, as in ^Int, and the ^ after a pointer that gives what it points to, as in p^. Both are the same token for the compiler.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.type.mialu
patterns.comment: The colon of a type separator, and of the two bounds of an array slice, as in a[1:4].

patterns.name: keyword.operator.ellipsis.mialu
patterns.comment: The ... that stands where the body of a foreign procedure would be. It comes before the dot of a field access, so its dots are not taken for that.

patterns.name: punctuation.accessor.dot.mialu
patterns.comment: The dot of a field access, as in p.age. The tokens ..< and ..<= of a range come before it, so their dots are not taken for it.

patterns.name: punctuation.section.brackets.mialu
patterns.comment: The brackets of an array type, of a subscript and of a slice, and the braces of an array literal.

patterns.name: entity.name.label.mialu
patterns.comment: The label of a statement: an @ directly followed by a name, as in @outer -> or @outer for.
A break or a continue that names a statement, which is written without the @, as in break outer.

patterns.name: entity.name.function.call.mialu
patterns.comment: A name that is directly followed by an opening parenthesis is a call. The reserved words come first, so proc( is not one.

patterns.name: keyword.control.import.mialu
patterns.comment: The words of import foreign js "name" and of foreign js ->, which declare the procedures that come from JavaScript.

patterns.name: storage.type.enum.mialu
patterns.comment: The word that starts the definition of an enum, as in Color :: enum Int ->.

patterns.name: storage.type.struct.mialu
patterns.comment: The word that starts the definition of a struct or of a field that is a struct, as in Person :: struct ->.

patterns.name: storage.modifier.const.mialu
patterns.comment: The length of an array type that is the number of elements of the array literal that it starts, as in [const]Int { 1, 2 }.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.word.mialu
patterns.comment: The logical operators and, or and not. Not is skipped when it is the start of the operator not=, which is highlighted as an operator.
